triples.tail_surface: Be sure that bearings are fully lubricated
triples.evidence_text: 1) Be sure that bearings are fully lubricated.

triples.head_surface: Unpainted machined surfaces which are subject to corrosion
triples.head_canonical_zh: 易腐蚀的未涂漆加工表面
triples.tail_surface: protected by some corrosive resistant coating
triples.evidence_text:
2) Unpainted machined surfaces which are subject to corrosion should be protected by some
               corrosive resistant coating.

triples.tail_surface:
The shaft should be rotated 10 to 15 revolutions by hand periodically in order to spread
               lubricant over all the bearing surfaces
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 定期手动盘车10至15圈以将润滑剂分布到所有轴承表面
triples.evidence_text:
3) The shaft should be rotated 10 to 15 revolutions by hand periodically in order to spread
               lubricant over all the bearing surfaces.

triples.head_surface: pump shaft does not begin to sag
triples.tail_surface: do not leave the shaft in the same position each time
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 每次盘车不使轴停留在同一位置
triples.evidence_text:
In order to insure that the pump shaft does not
               begin to sag in horizontal pumps, do not leave the shaft in the same position each time.

triples.tail_surface:
the bearings should be cleaned
               and packed with petrolatum or other suitable anti-rust agents
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 清洗轴承并填充凡士林或其他合适的防锈剂
triples.evidence_text:
If periodical rotation of the shaft is not possible, the bearings should be cleaned
               and packed with petrolatum or other suitable anti-rust agents, according to the advice of a
               reputable supplier.
